outro-2.keyframe: Dusk, close: a phone lying on a wooden porch step showing a message thread, the tiny glowing character sitting beside it. No people in frame.

outro-3.motion: The phone's screen locks and goes black; the porch light glows warm in the darkness behind it.
outro-3.foley: phone lock CLICK (cue c03, lands before 'Delivered')

outro-4.keyframe: Night: darkness, a warm porch light glowing, fireflies beginning to rise over the lawn.
outro-4.motion: Fireflies rise slowly through the dark around the glowing porch light.

outro-5.keyframe: Night lawn full of drifting fireflies, one larger soft mint-green glow among them: the tiny character floating up.
outro-5.motion: The fireflies drift upward; the character's mint-green glow floats up among them like one of them.

outro-6.keyframe: Night lawn: drifting fireflies rising into a dark sky, the small glowing mint-green character floating up among them, higher and dimmer.
outro-6.motion: The glows drift higher and dimmer as everything slowly fades to black. The character stays exactly the same throughout: same face, same black pixel sunglasses with three green dots on each lens, one single little green flag.
